customerSuccess.sectionHeading: Case study: Pierwsze Trzeźwe Pokolenie — from zero to 27 million views

movementIntro.heading: The first generation for whom sobriety is a choice, not a ban
movementIntro.body1: Pierwsze Trzeźwe Pokolenie ("First Sober Generation") is an initiative of the Columbus Foundation — a movement that wants to be exactly what its name says: the first generation for whom delaying first alcohol use becomes the norm, not the exception.
movementIntro.body2: Instead of lectures and bans — authentic ambassadors and honest stories, told in the language young people actually use with each other. Mateusz Kusznierewicz shows that success and real emotion can be built without substances. Łukasz Tchórzewski, known as "the TikTok Alcoholic," speaks plainly about what addiction really is. The result: education that doesn't sound like education.
movementIntro.statsBeforeAlt: View statistics before working with WeUnite
movementIntro.statsAfterAlt: View statistics after working with WeUnite

challengeBlock.heading: How do you talk about sobriety so young people actually want to listen?

cringe.title: Avoid the cringe effect
cringe.body: For young people, sobriety brings to mind dull lectures and bans that provoke rebellion. We had to build communication with no schoolteacher tone and no finger-wagging — stopping alcohol initiation with inspiration, not fear.

attention.title: Cut through the noise
attention.body: TikTok's and YouTube's algorithms reward quick entertainment. Our job was to slip real educational value into a format that would actually hold attention.

offline.title: Translate online into offline
offline.body: An online bubble isn't enough. The challenge was building a real educational support tool that would physically reach schools.

strategyStack.heading: The faces of the campaign you can't just scroll past.

glinka.blurb: Framed the project in business and personal-development terms. Showed Gen Z that discipline is the currency of the future — not another rule to break.
glinka.imageAlt: Bartłomiej Glinka, initiator of the Pierwsze Trzeźwe Pokolenie project

kusznierewicz.blurb: A legend of Polish sport. His face became a symbol of the alternative to substances — proof that real emotion and success live in sport and passion.
kusznierewicz.imageAlt: Mateusz Kusznierewicz — ambassador of the Pierwsze Trzeźwe Pokolenie campaign

tchorzewski.blurb: We bet on brutally honest storytelling. The long-form video podcast built loyalty and watch time, while short clips from the same conversation went viral.
tchorzewski.imageAlt: Still from the video podcast recorded with Łukasz Tchórzewski for Pierwsze Trzeźwe Pokolenie

offlineBlock.heading: From the phone screen to the school hallway.
offlineBlock.body: Algorithms aren't everything. We initiated and closed partnerships with 5 schools. We designed dedicated posters that now physically hang in school hallways — the project became real support for principals and teachers.
offlineBlock.moreSchools: + 2 more schools in the Tri-City area

resultsBlock.heading: Smart content can generate astronomical numbers.
